unicode_names_from: Unicode 13.0.0, with the Unicode 14.0 name for U+180F; membership is explicit and does not vary with runtime Unicode properties

classes.warning: Preserved by class operations; remove U+FEFF explicitly only when its loss is intended.

classes.description: Invisible spacing, joining or mathematical format characters not assigned to another class.
classes.warning: These characters can control line breaking, Mongolian text or mathematical notation.
Join controls carry meaning in Persian, Arabic, Urdu, Indic scripts and emoji sequences.

classes.description: Bidirectional marks, embeddings, overrides, isolates and deprecated directional controls.
classes.warning: Direction controls can be required for correct Hebrew, Arabic and mixed-direction rendering.
Tag characters can participate in valid emoji and language-tag sequences.

classes.description: Mongolian, standard and supplementary variation selectors.
classes.warning: Variation selectors can change glyph identity or emoji presentation.

position_model.line: one-based; CRLF, lone CR and lone LF each advance one line
position_model.column: one-based Unicode scalar column; astral scalars count once
position_model.newline_position: a CR or LF occupies its pre-break column; the LF in CRLF is part of the same break
